source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Bring this item back to life.
3. Bring up the record using the buttons provided:

    ### Pre-test

    1.  You may perform a pre-test inspection if you think it is important. *Note: Some elements of the pre-test do not apply to trailer*
    2. Before the start of the test fill in the pre-test report.
    3. Once the test runs out of the tests it will ask if you would like to perform the pre-test again.
        * a. If the answer is yes, redo the pre-test. (goto 1)
        * b. If the answer is no, move onto the next test.
        
    ### Performance test

    1. Fill in the Performance test measurements.
    2. Once you are finished, hit the "Stop Performing Measurements" to stop the test.

    ### Post-test Measurements
